tk.sub.en: How TikTok runs this round: who sees the ads, how the approved budget is spent, how bids are placed, and whether the campaign starts live. The approved budget stays the ceiling either way.
tk.sub.zh: 这一轮在 TikTok 上怎么投：谁会看到广告、已批准的预算怎么花、怎样出价、是否上线即投放。无论哪种设置，已批准的预算都是花费上限。

tk.presetDefault.en: Defaults — US · everyone · lifetime budget · clicks · lowest cost · live
tk.presetDefault.zh: 默认 — 美国 · 全部人群 · 总预算 · 点击 · 最低成本 · 上线即投放

tk.savedWithWarning.en: Saved, but the launch will refuse until this is fixed: {warning}
tk.savedWithWarning.zh: 已保存，但修正前无法投放：{warning}

tk.locationsSearch.en: Add a country, state or city…

tk.locationsHint.en: TikTok's own location list. A young ad account may only be allowed some countries; delivery history opens more up.
tk.locationsHint.zh: 来自 TikTok 的地区列表。新广告账户可能只能投放部分国家，有投放历史后才会开放更多。

tk.placementHint.en: Automatic also spends on Pangle and the Global App Bundle; TikTok only keeps every impression on TikTok.
tk.placementHint.zh: 自动版位会把预算分到 Pangle 和 Global App Bundle；仅 TikTok 让每一次展示都留在 TikTok 上。

tk.dailyBudgetHint.en: TikTok's minimum is ${min} a day. The approved budget caps the whole campaign.
tk.dailyBudgetHint.zh: TikTok 最低为每日 ${min}。已批准的预算是整个广告活动的上限。

tk.durationHint.en: Blank = the budget at the daily minimum, at most {max} days.
tk.durationHint.zh: 留空 = 按每日最低预算折算，最多 {max} 天。

tk.scheduleHint.en: Blank start = 10 minutes after launch. Blank end = the run length above (lifetime) or open-ended (daily).
tk.scheduleHint.zh: 开始留空 = 投放后 10 分钟。结束留空 = 按上面的天数（总预算）或不设结束（每日）。

tk.moneyLifetime.en: ${budget} approved → ${share} per ad group × {groups} ad group(s), over {days} day(s).
tk.moneyLifetime.zh: 已批准 ${budget} → 每个广告组 ${share} × {groups} 个广告组，共 {days} 天。

tk.moneyDaily.en: ${daily}/day per ad group × {groups} ad group(s); the campaign stops at ${budget} in total.
tk.moneyDaily.zh: 每个广告组每日 ${daily} × {groups} 个广告组；整个广告活动到 ${budget} 即停止。

tk.moneyNoBudget.en: Set and approve the budget in the brief to see the split.
tk.moneyNoBudget.zh: 先在简报中设置并批准预算，即可看到拆分。

tk.shareTooSmall.en: Each share is below TikTok's ${min} minimum; use fewer copies or a larger budget.
tk.shareTooSmall.zh: 每份低于 TikTok 的 ${min} 最低要求；减少副本数或提高预算。

tk.bidAmountCpc.zh: 每次点击（按 CPC 计费）。

tk.bidAmountOcpm.zh: 每次落地页浏览（按 oCPM 计费）。

tk.noCapBody.en: Lowest cost is TikTok's BID_TYPE_NO_BID: maximum delivery, no ceiling on cost per result, spending the full ${budget} {per} at whatever the auction charges.
tk.noCapBody.zh: 最低成本即 TikTok 的 BID_TYPE_NO_BID：最大化投放，单次成本没有上限，会按竞价结果花完 {per} ${budget}。

tk.noCapCopies.en: With {n} auto-duplicate copies, that is up to ${total} once everything is approved.
tk.noCapCopies.zh: 加上 {n} 个自动复制的副本，审核通过后最多 ${total}。

tk.noCapFix.en: Pick a cost cap if that is not what you want.
tk.noCapFix.zh: 如果不希望这样，请选择成本上限。

tk.commentsOff.en: Turn comments off on these ads (comments usually help delivery)
tk.commentsOff.zh: 关闭这些广告的评论（评论通常有助于投放）

tk.liveHint.en: Delivering as soon as TikTok approves the ads.
tk.liveHint.zh: TikTok 审核通过后立即投放。

tk.pausedHint.en: Created but switched off; nothing spends until you turn the campaign on.
tk.pausedHint.zh: 创建后处于关闭状态；你打开广告活动前不会产生花费。

tk.autoDup.zh: 审核通过后自动复制广告组

tk.autoDupHint.en: 0 = off, up to {max}. Each copy runs the same ads with its own budget.
tk.autoDupHint.zh: 0 = 关闭，最多 {max} 个。每个副本投放同样的广告，各自有预算。

tk.autoDupLifetime.en: {n} copies: the approved budget is split across {groups} ad groups, ${share} each. The total never exceeds what was approved.
tk.autoDupLifetime.zh: {n} 个副本：已批准的预算会拆到 {groups} 个广告组，每个 ${share}。总额不会超过已批准的预算。

tk.autoDupDaily.en: {n} copies: each adds its own daily budget; the campaign's lifetime cap still stops the total at the approved budget.
tk.autoDupDaily.zh: {n} 个副本：每个都有自己的每日预算；广告活动的总预算上限仍会在已批准的预算处停止。

tk.deliverySub.en: What TikTok reports right now, and the controls: switch, budget, bid, schedule, copies. Every change is read back from TikTok.
tk.deliverySub.zh: TikTok 当前的实时状态与操作：开关、预算、出价、排期、副本。每次修改都会从 TikTok 回读确认。

tk.notApplied.en: TikTok accepted the request but the campaign did not change state; the next sweep will settle it (a suspended ad account behaves this way).
tk.notApplied.zh: TikTok 接受了请求，但广告活动状态未改变；下一次同步会确认（被封禁的广告账户会这样）。

tk.suspendedTitle.zh: 广告账户已被 TikTok 封禁。

tk.suspendedBody.en: Nothing delivers until TikTok restores it. Pulsar can relaunch this round on another ad account.
tk.suspendedBody.zh: 在 TikTok 恢复前不会投放。Pulsar 可以在另一个广告账户上重新投放这一轮。

tk.noGroups.en: TikTok returned no ad groups for this campaign.
tk.noGroups.zh: TikTok 未返回此广告活动的广告组。

tk.newBudgetLifetimeHint.en: Re-signed as the approved budget and split across {groups} active ad group(s). TikTok refuses a lifetime budget below what a group already spent.
tk.newBudgetLifetimeHint.zh: 作为已批准预算重新签署，并拆到 {groups} 个投放中的广告组。TikTok 不接受低于已花费金额的总预算。

tk.newBudgetDailyHint.en: Re-signed as the approved budget and set as the campaign's lifetime cap.
tk.newBudgetDailyHint.zh: 作为已批准预算重新签署，并设为广告活动的总预算上限。

tk.newDaily.en: New daily budget per ad group (USD)
tk.newDaily.zh: 每个广告组新的每日预算（USD）

tk.newDailyHint.en: Applied to every active ad group; the campaign still stops at {cap}.
tk.newDailyHint.zh: 应用到所有投放中的广告组；广告活动仍会在 {cap} 处停止。

tk.bidReplaceHint.en: A lowest-cost ad group cannot be given a bid; it is replaced by a capped copy with the same ads and switched off.
tk.bidReplaceHint.zh: 最低成本的广告组无法直接加出价；会用一个带上限、广告相同的副本替换并关闭原组。

tk.newEndHint.en: Applied to every active ad group, end of that day (UTC).
tk.newEndHint.zh: 应用到所有投放中的广告组，当天结束（UTC）。

tk.copiesLifetimeHint.en: The approved budget is re-shared across every ad group first, then the copies are created with the same ads.
tk.copiesLifetimeHint.zh: 先把已批准的预算重新拆分到所有广告组，再用同样的广告创建副本。

tk.copiesDailyHint.en: Each copy runs the daily budget with the same ads; the campaign cap bounds the total.
tk.copiesDailyHint.zh: 每个副本以每日预算投放同样的广告；总额受广告活动上限约束。

tk.endConfirmBody.en: The campaign is switched off on TikTok and closed here. An ended round cannot be turned back on; the next test is a new round.
tk.endConfirmBody.zh: 广告活动将在 TikTok 上关闭并在此结束。已结束的一轮无法重新开启；下一次测试是新的一轮。

tk.dailyChanged.en: Daily budget changed to {daily} per ad group.
tk.dailyChanged.zh: 每日预算已改为每个广告组 {daily}。

tka.sub.en: The Business Center Pulsar linked to your company, and the ad accounts inside it. Launches use a ready account with a TikTok handle; you can name the one you prefer.
tka.sub.zh: Pulsar 关联到你公司的 Business Center 及其中的广告账户。投放会使用已就绪且绑定 TikTok 账号的广告账户；你可以指定优先使用哪一个。

tka.noHandle.en: No handle linked — Pulsar is on it
tka.noHandle.zh: 未绑定账号 — Pulsar 处理中

tka.noAccounts.en: TikTok lists no ad accounts in this Business Center yet.
tka.noAccounts.zh: TikTok 尚未在此 Business Center 中列出广告账户。

tka.foot.en: Accounts are created and funded by Pulsar inside Pulsar's Business Center; you never handle a TikTok token.
tka.foot.zh: 广告账户由 Pulsar 在其 Business Center 内创建和充值；你无需处理 TikTok 令牌。

tkp.sub.en: Pulsar-wide shapes a producer can pick on a campaign: targeting, budget shape, schedule, bidding, launch state. Values travel — a launch keeps the settings it used even if the preset changes later.
tkp.sub.zh: 面向所有制片方的预设：定向、预算方式、排期、出价、上线状态。设置随投放走 — 预设之后修改，不影响已投放的活动。

tkp.none.en: No presets yet. Producers get the defaults (US, everyone, lifetime budget, clicks, lowest cost, live).
tkp.none.zh: 还没有预设。制片方会使用默认设置（美国、全部人群、总预算、点击、最低成本、上线即投放）。

tkp.deleteConfirm.en: Delete the preset “{name}”? Launches that used it keep their settings.
tkp.deleteConfirm.zh: 删除预设“{name}”？已使用它的投放会保留各自的设置。

tks.modeFake.en: Fixture mode: every launch goes to the fake TikTok inside this process and spends nothing. Real Business Centers connect only in Supabase mode (the studio-live launch config).
tks.modeFake.zh: 演示模式：所有投放都进入进程内的模拟 TikTok，不产生花费。真实 Business Center 只能在 Supabase 模式下连接（studio-live 启动配置）。

tks.modeSandbox.en: TikTok sandbox: objects are created in the sandbox ad account from the token in .env.local. Nothing is published and nothing is spent.
tks.modeSandbox.zh: TikTok 沙盒：使用 .env.local 中的令牌在沙盒广告账户中创建对象。不会发布，也不会产生花费。

tks.modeProduction.en: Production TikTok. Each Business Center is its own authorization: connect one, approve access on TikTok, come back here and link it to a company.
tks.modeProduction.zh: 生产环境 TikTok。每个 Business Center 都是一次独立授权：连接一个，在 TikTok 上批准访问，回到这里关联到公司。

tks.reachableValue.zh: {bcs} 个 Business Center 中的 {accounts} 个广告账户

tks.bcSub.en: A Business Center is a folder of ad accounts. Link one to a company and that company's launches pick a ready account with a TikTok handle inside it (the producer can name a preferred one). Assigning a single ad account remains as an explicit override.
tks.bcSub.zh: Business Center 是广告账户的集合。将其关联到一家公司后，该公司的投放会从中选择已就绪且绑定 TikTok 账号的广告账户（制片方可指定优先账户）。指定单个广告账户仍可作为显式覆盖。

tks.fp.used.zh: {campaigns} 个广告活动 · {active} 个开启 · 地区 {geo}/{full}

tks.lastTick.en: Last tick: {polled} campaigns polled, {synced} result rows written, {duplicated} ad group copies made.
tks.lastTick.zh: 上次运行：轮询 {polled} 个广告活动，写入 {synced} 行结果，创建 {duplicated} 个广告组副本。

tkm.empty.en: Nothing is launched on TikTok yet.
tkm.empty.zh: 还没有在 TikTok 上投放的广告活动。

tkd.relaunchHint.en: A new launch of the same approved ads and budget on another ready ad account inside the company's Business Center. Only for an ended or failed campaign.
tkd.relaunchHint.zh: 用公司 Business Center 内的另一个已就绪广告账户，重新投放同样的已批准广告与预算。仅适用于已结束或失败的广告活动。

promote.block.settings_invalid.en: the launch settings do not fit the approved budget; open Launch settings
promote.block.settings_invalid.zh: 投放设置与已批准的预算不匹配；请打开投放设置
